# Repo map

Playbook for running Claude Code (with RTK + Headroom) in Docker on a Mac — Case 1 `claude-box`, Case 2 VS Code Dev Container — plus a no-Docker Linux VM install and the project template `new-project` copies.

## Start here
- [README.md](README.md) — Mac Cases 1–2, RTK + Headroom, troubleshooting; points at the Linux VM guide.
- [secure-agent-template/](secure-agent-template/) — files `new-project` (and the Linux VM guide) copy into each repo. Change defaults here.
- [secure-agent-playbook.sh](secure-agent-playbook.sh) — installer; the Case 1 Dockerfile and the `new-project` / `claude-box` zsh helpers live inside it.
- [tests/POLICY.md](tests/POLICY.md) — read before touching any test; fix production code, not tests.

## /
Apple Silicon + zsh for Cases 1–2. Linux VM host install is a separate doc. Edit the template, not `~/.config/secure-agent-template/`, then re-run the Mac setup script.

- [README.md](README.md) — Mac Cases 1–2 plus pointers to the Linux VM and existing-project upgrade docs.
- [secure-agent-playbook.sh](secure-agent-playbook.sh) — host installer; Case 1 Dockerfile (RTK + Headroom) and zsh helpers (`new-project <name>`, `claude-box`).
- [docker-cheat-sheet.md](docker-cheat-sheet.md) — Docker primer mapped onto `claude-box` and the Case 2 Dev Container.
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md) — project standards for agents working on this playbook repo.
- [.gitignore](.gitignore) — Python-oriented ignore plus Claude local settings and Headroom session files.
- [secure-agent-template/](secure-agent-template/) — see its section below.
- [docs/](docs/) — see its section below.
- [tests/](tests/) — see its section below.

## docs/
Agent index, Linux VM host install, and the existing-project upgrade guide. Refresh this map after moves/adds/deletes.

- [remote-linux-vm.md](docs/remote-linux-vm.md) — VS Code Remote SSH + Claude/RTK/Headroom on the VM user; no `claude-box` or Dev Container.
- [repo-map.md](docs/repo-map.md) — this file.
- [upgrade-existing-projects.md](docs/upgrade-existing-projects.md) — add status line/RTK/Headroom to old projects (Case 1 vs 2); remove leftover Cursor files.

## secure-agent-template/
Source tree copied to `~/.config/secure-agent-template/` and into each `new-project`. Change defaults here.

- [CLAUDE.md](secure-agent-template/CLAUDE.md) — standards pasted into every new project.
- [environment-notes.md](secure-agent-template/environment-notes.md) — copied into every project: status line, RTK, Headroom, per-project VS Code colors, git credentials (Keychain, not `store`).
- [.gitignore](secure-agent-template/.gitignore) — secrets, build output, Claude local/Headroom wrap files.
- [.claudeignore](secure-agent-template/.claudeignore) — advisory skip list for Claude context.

## secure-agent-template/.claude/
Claude Code project config shipped to new repos.

- [settings.json](secure-agent-template/.claude/settings.json) — `permissions.deny`, status line, `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` for Headroom.
- [statusline.sh](secure-agent-template/.claude/statusline.sh) — context % / model / rate-limit bar; needs `jq`.
- [skills/folder-explore/SKILL.md](secure-agent-template/.claude/skills/folder-explore/SKILL.md) — how to build or refresh `docs/repo-map.md`.

## secure-agent-template/.devcontainer/
Case 2 Dev Container recipe. Case 1 ignores this folder.

- [devcontainer.json](secure-agent-template/.devcontainer/devcontainer.json) — Claude feature + extension, auth volume, Headroom env/port, `postCreate` setup + `postStart` proxy.
- [setup-agent-tools.sh](secure-agent-template/.devcontainer/setup-agent-tools.sh) — idempotent install of jq, RTK, Headroom; Claude hook + routing; no arg (legacy `claude`/`both` accepted, `cursor` rejected).
- [start-headroom.sh](secure-agent-template/.devcontainer/start-headroom.sh) — start `headroom proxy` on `127.0.0.1:8787` if unhealthy; beacon off.

## tests/
Bash test suite for the installer and template. Run `./tests/run.sh`; `RUN_RUNTIME=1` adds Docker smokes. Not copied into projects.

- [POLICY.md](tests/POLICY.md) — write → sabotage → fail → revert → pass → LOCK; never edit locked tests without owner OK.
- [run.sh](tests/run.sh) — runner: contract, unit, installer layers; runtime only with `RUN_RUNTIME=1`.
- [helpers.sh](tests/helpers.sh) — assert_* functions, rtk/headroom/curl stubs, isolated PATH builder.
- [contract/template.sh](tests/contract/template.sh) — template inventory (no Cursor files), JSON parse, `bash -n`/`zsh -n` syntax.
- [contract/cases.sh](tests/contract/cases.sh) — Claude settings keys and Case 2 `devcontainer.json` fields.
- [contract/dockerfile.sh](tests/contract/dockerfile.sh) — Case 1 Dockerfile embedded in the installer.
- [unit/setup-agent-tools.sh](tests/unit/setup-agent-tools.sh) — setup script: no-arg, legacy args, cursor/invalid rejected.
- [unit/start-headroom.sh](tests/unit/start-headroom.sh) — proxy starter: skip, healthy, start, timeout paths.
- [unit/statusline.sh](tests/unit/statusline.sh) — status line output from fixture JSON.
- [installer/playbook.sh](tests/installer/playbook.sh) — installer with fake HOME + stub docker; `new-project` scaffolding and legacy-arg note.
- [installer/claude-box.sh](tests/installer/claude-box.sh) — `claude-box` docker argv with stub docker.
- [runtime/case1-image.sh](tests/runtime/case1-image.sh) — real Case 1 image: binaries + Headroom health.
- [runtime/devcontainers.sh](tests/runtime/devcontainers.sh) — real Case 2 Dev Container via `@devcontainers/cli`.
- [fixtures/](tests/fixtures/) — four status-line input JSON files (low / mid / high / missing limits).

## Dotfile config (this playbook repo)
Config for agents working *on* the playbook, not what `new-project` copies. `.devcontainer/` here mounts the Docker socket and is not the template.

- [.claude/settings.json](.claude/settings.json) — playbook-repo Claude deny list and status line (no Headroom URL).
- [.claude/statusline.sh](.claude/statusline.sh) — same status-line script as the template.
- [.claude/skills/folder-explore/SKILL.md](.claude/skills/folder-explore/SKILL.md) — repo-map skill used in this repo.
- [.claudeignore](.claudeignore) — secrets and build output skipped from Claude auto-context.
- [.devcontainer/devcontainer.json](.devcontainer/devcontainer.json) — this sandbox: Claude volume + host Docker socket; not copied by `new-project`.
- [.devcontainer/setup-agent-tools.sh](.devcontainer/setup-agent-tools.sh) — copy of the template script; not referenced by this repo's `devcontainer.json`.
- [.devcontainer/start-headroom.sh](.devcontainer/start-headroom.sh) — copy of the template script; not referenced by this repo's `devcontainer.json`.
